Build a functional integrations connection flow for the CROBOT/ConvertScan CRO tool. Working directory: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT. ## Context The app is React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui + Supabase. The user-facing integrations page at `src/pages/Integrations.tsx` currently shows 4 integrations (Google Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Google Search Console) all with "Coming Soon" badges and disabled buttons. The Supabase `integrations` table exists and is ready to use. ## Database Schema ```ts interface IntegrationRow { id: string; user_id: string; provider: "hotjar" | "google_analytics" | "clarity" | "search_console"; access_token: string | null; // we'll store the tracking ID / site ID here refresh_token: string | null; is_active: boolean; connected_at: string; } type IntegrationInsert = Pick & Partial>; type IntegrationUpdate = Partial>; ``` The Supabase client is at `src/lib/supabase.ts` (default export). Auth context is at `src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx` — use `const { profile } = useAuth()` to get user id via `profile?.id`. ## Task 1: Create `src/hooks/use-integrations.ts` Build a React Query hook file with: ```ts // useIntegrations() — fetches all integrations for the current user // useConnectIntegration() — mutation: upserts an integration (inserts or updates) // useDisconnectIntegration() — mutation: sets is_active=false, clears access_token ``` - `useIntegrations` query key: `["integrations"]` - For `useConnectIntegration`: upsert to `integrations` table using supabase `.from("integrations").upsert(...)` with `onConflict: "user_id,provider"`. Set `is_active: true`, `access_token: trackingId`. - For `useDisconnectIntegration`: update row to `{ is_active: false, access_token: null }` where `user_id=X AND provider=Y`. - After each mutation, `queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["integrations"] })`. - Import `useQueryClient` from `@tanstack/react-query`. - Import `useAuth` from `@/contexts/AuthContext`. ## Task 2: Rewrite `src/pages/Integrations.tsx` Replace the "Coming Soon" page with a fully functional connection flow. Requirements: ### Integration configs (update INTEGRATIONS array): ```ts [ { id: "google_analytics" as const, name: "Google Analytics 4", icon: BarChart2, color: "text-orange-500", bg: "bg-orange-50", description: "Connect your GA4 property to enrich CRO recommendations with traffic and behavior data.", inputLabel: "Measurement ID", inputPlaceholder: "G-XXXXXXXXXX", inputHint: "Find this in GA4 → Admin → Data Streams → your stream → Measurement ID", benefits: ["Bounce rate context for each page", "Traffic source analysis", "Session duration insights"], }, { id: "hotjar" as const, name: "Hotjar", icon: Flame, color: "text-red-500", bg: "bg-red-50", description: "Import heatmap and session recording data for deeper conversion insights.", inputLabel: "Site ID", inputPlaceholder: "1234567", inputHint: "Find your Site ID in Hotjar → Settings → Sites & Organizations", benefits: ["Heatmap analysis integration", "Rage click detection", "Scroll depth data"], }, { id: "clarity" as const, name: "Microsoft Clarity", icon: MousePointer2, color: "text-blue-500", bg: "bg-blue-50", description: "Free heatmaps and session recordings to complement your CRO audits.", inputLabel: "Project ID", inputPlaceholder: "abc1234xyz", inputHint: "Find your Project ID in Clarity → Settings → your project", benefits: ["Free session recordings", "Click heatmaps", "Dead click detection"], }, { id: "search_console" as const, name: "Google Search Console", icon: Search, color: "text-green-500", bg: "bg-green-50", description: "Understand which search keywords bring visitors who don't convert.", inputLabel: "Property URL", inputPlaceholder: "https://yoursite.com", inputHint: "Enter the exact property URL as listed in Google Search Console", benefits: ["Keyword performance data", "Click-through rate analysis", "Search intent matching"], }, ] ``` ### Per-integration card behavior: - Use `useIntegrations()` to get connected integrations - For each integration, check if connected: `const connected = integrations.find(i => i.provider === id && i.is_active)` - **Connected state**: Show green "Connected" badge; switch is ON; "Disconnect" button (outline/destructive variant) - **Disconnected state**: Show grey badge "Not connected"; switch is OFF; "Connect" button (primary) - "Connect" button opens a Dialog (shadcn Dialog) with: - Title: "Connect {name}" - Input field with `inputLabel`, `inputPlaceholder` - Help text under input: `inputHint` (text-xs text-muted-foreground) - "Save & Connect" button — calls `connectIntegration.mutate({ provider: id, trackingId: value })` - Cancel button - Disable button and show Loader2 while `connectIntegration.isPending` - After success: close dialog, toast.success("Connected successfully") - After error: toast.error("Failed to connect. Please check your ID and try again.") - "Disconnect" button calls `disconnectIntegration.mutate({ provider: id })` - While `disconnectIntegration.isPending`: show Loader2 spinner inline - After success: toast.success("{name} disconnected") ### Loading state: When `useIntegrations()` is loading, render skeletons (4 card-shaped Skeleton components). ### Design system: - No "Coming Soon" badges anywhere - Use `bg-card` not `bg-white` - Use `text-muted-foreground` not hardcoded text-slate-600 - All color tokens are semantic (bg-orange-50 for icon bg is fine since it's brand color) - Switch toggle: when connected `checked={true}` clicking it calls disconnect; when disconnected clicking it opens the connect dialog - Keep the benefits list in each card ### At top of page, add a connected count summary: ```tsx
{connectedCount} of {total} integrations connected
``` ## Conventions: - No `any` types - All hooks are called before any conditionals - Use `import type` for type-only imports - shadcn Dialog: `import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter } from "@/components/ui/dialog"` - Don't use `bg-muted/40/50` (invalid — use `bg-muted/40`) - Imports from `@tanstack/react-query`: `useQuery`, `useMutation`, `useQueryClient` Write both files completely. Do not use placeholder comments like "// same as before".

Here is a summary of what was built:

## What was built

### `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/src/hooks/use-integrations.ts`

Three React Query hooks:

- `useIntegrations()` — queries `integrations` table filtered by `profile.id`, query key `["integrations"]`, enabled only when user is authenticated, 1-minute stale time.
- `useConnectIntegration()` — mutation that calls `.upsert(..., { onConflict: "user_id,provider" })` with `is_active: true` and the provided `trackingId` stored in `access_token`. Invalidates the integrations query on success.
- `useDisconnectIntegration()` — mutation that sets `{ is_active: false, access_token: null }` scoped to `user_id` + `provider`. Invalidates on success.

All three use `profile?.id` from `useAuth()` and import `useQueryClient` from `@tanstack/react-query`. No `any` types anywhere.

### `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/src/pages/Integrations.tsx`

Fully replaced the static "Coming Soon" page with:

- **`ConnectDialog`** — shadcn `Dialog` with a labelled `Input`, `inputHint` below it, Enter-key submission, loading state on the "Save & Connect" button via `Loader2`, clears input on close.
- **`IntegrationCard`** — reads connected state from the `useIntegrations` data, renders a green "Connected" badge with `CheckCircle2` or a grey "Not connected" badge with `Circle`. `Switch` toggle calls connect/disconnect. "Disconnect" button uses destructive hover styles and shows an inline `Loader2` during the mutation. "Connect" button is the primary action for disconnected state.
- **`IntegrationsSkeleton`** — four card-shaped skeletons with matching layout (icon, badges, text lines, button) shown while `isLoading` is true.
- **Connected count summary** — rendered top-right only after loading completes: `{connectedCount} of 4 integrations connected`.
- All colors use semantic tokens (`text-muted-foreground`, `border-border`). The only branded colors (`bg-orange-50`, `text-red-500`, etc.) are intentional per-integration brand colours. No hardcoded `text-slate-*` remains.
